        if forceTime <= 0 and distToTarget > releaseDistance then
            clearTarget()
            chase_cd = 0
            return
        end

        if chase_cd <= 0 then
            if distToTarget > lo.attackDistance then
                humanoid:MoveTo(targetPos)
            else
                CommonFunc:StopMove(bandit)
            end
        end

        if atkCD <= 0 then
            local isObs = EnemyHelper:IsModelObstructionByCollsionGroup(bandit,targetModel)
            if not isObs and distToTarget <= lo.attackDistance and not bandit:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.NPCFreezed) then
                if tool then
                    tool:Activate()
                end
                atkCD = lo.attackCD
                if lo.attackType then
                    if lo.attackType == GameEnum.EnemyAttackType.SuicideBomb then
                        atkCD = 999999
                        if tool then
                            AudioHelper:PlayEffect("引信点燃",tool:FindFirstChild("Handle"))
                        end
                        task.defer(function()
                            local sec = 3
                            local bombTime = workspace.DistributedGameTime + sec
                            local highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
                            highlight.Name = "自爆高亮"
                            highlight.Parent = bandit
                            highlight.Enabled = false

                            local waitTime = 0.1
                            while true do
                                task.wait(waitTime)
                                if not bandit:IsDescendantOf(workspace) or not bandit:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Bandit) or humanoid.Health <= 0 then return end
                                local cd = bombTime - workspace.DistributedGameTime
                                waitTime = math.max(cd / sec,0.1)
                                if cd > 0 then
                                    AudioHelper:PlayEffect("beep",humanoidRootPart)
                                    highlight.Enabled = true
                                    task.delay(waitTime * 0.5,function()
                                        highlight.Enabled = false
                                    end)
                                else
                                    break
                                end
                            end

                            if tool then
                                tool:Destroy()
                                tool = nil
                            end

                            local explosion = Instance.new("Explosion")
                            explosion.Position = humanoidRootPart.Position
                            explosion.BlastPressure = 0
                            explosion.BlastRadius = 10
                            explosion.DestroyJointRadiusPercent = 0
                            explosion.ExplosionType = Enum.ExplosionType.Craters
                            explosion.TimeScale = 1
                            explosion.Visible = true
                            explosion.Parent = workspace
                            local damagedTargets = {}
                            explosion.Hit:Connect(function(part:BasePart, distance:number)
                                local hitModel = part and part:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
                                if not hitModel or damagedTargets[hitModel] then return end
                                local player = game.Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(hitModel)
                                if player then
                                    if part ~= hitModel:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then return end
                                    damagedTargets[hitModel] = true
                                    GameHelper:PlayerTakeDamage(player,atkDamage,nil,nil,{DamageSource = GameEnum.DamageSource.Explosion, HitPosition = humanoidRootPart.Position, SuppressHitReaction = true})
                                    EffectHelper.PlayVisualEffectS2C:FireClient(player,"震屏",10 - math.max(distance,9))
                                elseif escortTargets[hitModel] and GameHelper:CharacterIsAlive(hitModel) then
                                    damagedTargets[hitModel] = true
                                    GameHelper:NPCTakeDamage(bandit,hitModel,atkDamage,GameEnum.DamageSource.Explosion,{DamageSource = GameEnum.DamageSource.Explosion, HitPosition = humanoidRootPart.Position, SuppressHitReaction = true})
                                end
                            end)

                            humanoidRootPart.Anchored = true
                            AudioHelper:PlayEffect("爆炸",humanoidRootPart)
                            humanoid:Destroy()
                            GameHelper:DestroyAndSmashTarget(bandit,5,100)
                        end)
                    elseif GameEnum.EnemyAttackType[lo.attackType] then
                        if targetPlayer then
                            fireNearbyNpcVisual(GameHelper.EnemyGunAttackS2C, bandit, targetPlayer, targetPlayer, atkDamage)
                        elseif targetEscort and atkDamage > 0 then
                            fireNearbyNpcVisual(NPCGunVisualS2C, bandit, targetEscort)
                            GameHelper:NPCTakeDamage(bandit,targetEscort,atkDamage)
                        end
                    end
                else
                    if targetPlayer then
                        if atkDamage > 0 then
                            GameHelper:PlayerTakeDamage(targetPlayer,atkDamage,bandit)
                        end
                        if v_hungerDamage.Value > 0 then
                            GameHelper:PlayerTakeHungerDamage(targetPlayer,v_hungerDamage.Value,bandit)
                        end
                    elseif targetEscort and atkDamage > 0 then
                        GameHelper:NPCTakeDamage(bandit,targetEscort,atkDamage)
                    end
                    AudioHelper:PlayEffect(hitSounds[math.random(1,#hitSounds)],humanoidRootPart)
                end

                CommonFunc:StopMove(bandit)
                chase_cd = 0.5
                if isTargetAlive() then
                    local attackedTarget = getTargetModel()
                    task.spawn(function()
                        task.wait(0.5)
                        if not bandit or not bandit:IsDescendantOf(workspace) or not bandit:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Bandit) then return end
                        if getTargetModel() ~= attackedTarget then return end
                        chase_cd = 0.5
                        if lo.attackType and GameEnum.EnemyAttackType[lo.attackType] and distToTarget < lo.attackDistance * 0.5 then
                            humanoid:MoveTo(humanoidRootPart.Position - (offset * CommonEnum.XZ).Unit * 10)
                        end
                        ValueHelper:SetBonusValueValue(bandit,NpcAttributeValue.walkSpeed,"攻击后减速",-attackWalkSpeedDown)
                        task.wait(1)
                        ValueHelper:SetBonusValueValue(bandit,NpcAttributeValue.walkSpeed,"攻击后减速",0)
                    end)
                else
                    clearTarget()
                end
            end
        end
    end))

local BeastAttributeValue = ValueHelper.ValueModel.BeastAttributeValue

local AnimalBuddyValue = ValueHelper.ValueModel.AnimalBuddyValue

local _config = game.ReplicatedStorage.Jobs:FindFirstChild("驯兽师"):FindFirstChild("猛兽")

function setPartsTransparency(folder:Folder,Transparency:number)
    for _,part:BasePart in ipairs(folder:GetDescendants()) do
        if part:IsA("BasePart") then
            part.Transparency = Transparency
        end
    end
end

math.randomseed(tick())
function onTagAdded(buddy:Model,connections:{RBXScriptConnection})
    local humanoidRootPart:Part = buddy:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local SuckBloodFolder = buddy:FindFirstChild("吸血饰品")
    local PlunderFolder = buddy:FindFirstChild("铁饰品")

    local c_valueUpRate = _config:FindFirstChild("每级数值提升")

    local baseAtkDamage = ValueHelper:WaitBonusValueValue(buddy,BuddyAttributeValue.atkDamage,"基础")
    local baseAttackCD = ValueHelper:WaitBonusValueValue(buddy,BuddyAttributeValue.attackCD,"基础")
    local baseBodySize = ValueHelper:WaitBonusValueValue(buddy,BuddyAttributeValue.bodySize,"基础")

    local v_ownerPlayer:ObjectValue = ValueHelper:FindValue(buddy,AnimalBuddyValue.ownerPlayer)

    local v_level:NumberValue = ValueHelper:FindValue(buddy,BeastAttributeValue.level)
    local v_meatEaten:NumberValue = ValueHelper:FindValue(buddy,BeastAttributeValue.meatEaten)
    local v_deadBodyEaten:NumberValue = ValueHelper:FindValue(buddy,BeastAttributeValue.deadBodyEaten)
    local v_ironEaten:NumberValue = ValueHelper:FindValue(buddy,BeastAttributeValue.ironEaten)

    local v_bodySize:NumberValue = ValueHelper:FindValue(buddy,BuddyAttributeValue.bodySize)

    -- 升级/形态变换
    local onLevelUp = function()
        EffectHelper:PlayWeldConstraintEffect("变化形态",humanoidRootPart,3)
        AudioHelper:PlayEffect("猛兽交互音效",humanoidRootPart)
    end

    setPartsTransparency(SuckBloodFolder,1)
    setPartsTransparency(PlunderFolder,1)
    table.insert(connections,v_meatEaten.Changed:Connect(function()
        if buddy:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.BeastMaxLevel) then return end
        
        local v_targetNum = _config:FindFirstChild("升级吃肉需求"):FindFirstChild(tostring(v_level.Value + 1))
        if not v_targetNum then
            buddy:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.BeastMaxLevel)
            return
        end

        if v_meatEaten.Value >= v_targetNum.value then
            v_meatEaten.Value -= v_targetNum.value
            v_level.Value += 1

            local curValueRate = v_level.Value * c_valueUpRate.Value
            ValueHelper:SetBonusValueValue(buddy,BuddyAttributeValue.atkDamage,"等级加成",curValueRate * baseAtkDamage)
            -- ValueHelper:SetBonusValueValue(buddy,BuddyAttributeValue.attackCD,"等级加成",curValueRate * -baseAttackCD)
            ValueHelper:SetBonusValueValue(buddy,BuddyAttributeValue.bodySize,"等级加成",curValueRate * baseBodySize)

            onLevelUp()
        end
    end))
    table.insert(connections,v_deadBodyEaten.Changed:Connect(function()
        if buddy:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.BeastCanSuckBlood) then return end

        local v_targetNum = _config:FindFirstChild("获取吸血技能喂食次数")
        if not v_targetNum then return end

        if v_deadBodyEaten.Value >= v_targetNum.value then
            buddy:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.BeastCanSuckBlood)
            setPartsTransparency(SuckBloodFolder,0)

            onLevelUp()
        end
    end))
    table.insert(connections,v_ironEaten.Changed:Connect(function()
        if buddy:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.BeastCanPlunder) then return end

        local v_targetNum = _config:FindFirstChild("获取掠夺铁技能喂食次数")
        if not v_targetNum then return end

        if v_ironEaten.Value >= v_targetNum.value then
            buddy:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.BeastCanPlunder)
            setPartsTransparency(PlunderFolder,0)

            onLevelUp()
        end
    end))
    table.insert(connections,v_bodySize.Changed:Connect(function()
        buddy:ScaleTo(v_bodySize.Value)
    end))
    table.insert(connections,GameHelper.onNpcTakeDamage.Event:Connect(function(attacker:Model,npc:Model,damage:number,damageSource:number?)
        if attacker ~= buddy then return end

        local player = v_ownerPlayer.Value
        if not GameHelper:isAlive(player) then return end

        if buddy:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.BeastCanSuckBlood) then
            -- 吸血
            local v_rate = _config:FindFirstChild("吸血概率")
            if math.random() <= v_rate.Value then
                local v_value = _config:FindFirstChild("吸取血量")
                GameHelper:PlayerForceHeal(player,v_value.Value)
                EffectHelper.PlayVisualEffectS2C:FireAllClients("吸血",player.Character,npc)
            end
        end

        if not GameHelper:CharacterIsAlive(npc) then
            if buddy:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.BeastCanPlunder) then
                -- 爆铁
                local v_rate = _config:FindFirstChild("爆铁概率")
                if math.random() <= v_rate.Value then
                    local v_id = _config:FindFirstChild("爆铁Id")
                    ResourcesItemHelper:CreateItem(v_id.Value,npc:GetPivot())
                end
            end

            GameHelper:MarkCharacterStats(player,GameEnum.CharacterStatsId.beastKill,1)
        end

    end))
end

    buddy:RemoveTag(GameEnum.Tag.BeastBuddy)

    if not isResItem then return end

    local onEat = function()
        ResourcesItemHelper:DestroyItem(resItem)

        onEat()
    end
end)"},{"id":369,"text":"local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local CommonFunc = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("framework"):WaitForChild("CommonFunc"))
local CommonEnum = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Common"):WaitForChild("CommonEnum"))
local GameEnum = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("GameEnum"))
local ValueHelper = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("ValueHelper"))
local EnemyHelper = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("EnemyHelper"))
local GameHelper = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("GameHelper"))
local ResourcesItemHelper = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("ResourcesItemHelper"))
local AudioHelper = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("AudioHelper"))

local EnemyValue = ValueHelper.ValueModel.EnemyValue
local NpcAttributeValue = ValueHelper.ValueModel.NpcAttributeValue
local hitSounds = {"近战武器Hit1","近战武器Hit2"}
math.randomseed(tick())

function onTagAdded(destroyer:Model,connections:{RBXScriptConnection})
    destroyer:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.NPCAutoJump)
    local humanoidRootPart:Part = destroyer.PrimaryPart
    local humanoid:Humanoid = destroyer:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Humanoid")
    humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Seated,false)
    humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Swimming,false)
    humanoid.BreakJointsOnDeath = false
    -- humanoid.NameOcclusion = Enum.NameOcclusion.NoOcclusion
    humanoid.DisplayDistanceType = Enum.HumanoidDisplayDistanceType.None
    CommonFunc:SetCollisionGroup(destroyer,GameEnum.CollisionGroup.Enemy)
    local id = ValueHelper:FindValueValue(destroyer,EnemyValue.id)
    local atkDamage = ValueHelper:FindValueValue(destroyer,EnemyValue.atkDamage)
    local v_targetCraft:ObjectValue = ValueHelper:FindValue(destroyer,EnemyValue.targetCraft)
    local tool:Tool = destroyer:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Tool")


    local lo = EnemyHelper:GetLo(id)
    humanoid.NameDisplayDistance = lo.aggroDistance

    local nextAtkTime = workspace.DistributedGameTime + lo.attackCD
    local nextHeartbeatTime = workspace.DistributedGameTime + 0.2
    local nextCheckHitTreeTime = workspace.DistributedGameTime + 1

    local _,modelSize = destroyer:GetBoundingBox()
    table.insert(connections,humanoid.HealthChanged:Connect(function(health)
        if health <= 0 then
            GameHelper:EnemyDeathDrop(destroyer)

            if tool then
                tool:Destroy()
            end
            destroyer:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.PlayerRagdoll)
            destroyer:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.EnemyDeath)
            destroyer:RemoveTag(GameEnum.Tag.Enemy)
            destroyer:RemoveTag(GameEnum.Tag.Destroyer)
        end
    end))

    table.insert(connections,RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt:number)
        if humanoidRootPart.Anchored then return end

        local gameTimeNow = workspace.DistributedGameTime
        if gameTimeNow < nextHeartbeatTime then return end

        if not GameHelper:CharacterIsAlive(v_targetCraft.Value) then
            local newTarget = GameHelper:GetClosestDestructibleCraft(destroyer,lo.aggroDistance)
            if not newTarget and v_targetCraft.Value then
                -- 旧目标死了，并且没有新目标，走回出生地
                humanoid:Move(Vector3.zero)
            end
            v_targetCraft.Value = newTarget
        end

        if GameHelper:CharacterIsAlive(v_targetCraft.Value) then        
            if gameTimeNow >= nextAtkTime then
                local op = OverlapParams.new()
                op:AddToFilter(v_targetCraft.Value)
                op.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include
                local cframe,size = destroyer:GetBoundingBox()
                local hits = workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(cframe,size,op)
                if #hits > 0 then
                    if not destroyer:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.NPCFreezed) then
                        if tool then
                            tool:Activate()
                        end
                        nextAtkTime = gameTimeNow + lo.attackCD
                        GameHelper:CraftTakeDamage(destroyer,v_targetCraft.Value,atkDamage)
                        CommonFunc:StopMove(destroyer)
                        AudioHelper:PlayEffect(hitSounds[math.random(1,#hitSounds)],humanoidRootPart)
                    end
                    humanoid:Move(Vector3.zero)
                else
                    local offsetToTarget:Vector3 = v_targetCraft.Value:GetPivot().Position - humanoidRootPart.Position
                    humanoid:Move((offsetToTarget * CommonEnum.XZ).Unit)
                end
            else
                humanoid:Move(Vector3.zero)
            end
        end

        if gameTimeNow >= nextCheckHitTreeTime then
            nextCheckHitTreeTime = gameTimeNow + 1

            -- 检测碰撞树木
            local op = OverlapParams.new()
            op:AddToFilter(CollectionService:GetTagged(GameEnum.Tag.Tree))
            op:AddToFilter(CollectionService:GetTagged(GameEnum.Tag.BigTree))
            op.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include

            local hits = workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(destroyer:GetPivot(),modelSize * 1.1,op)
            local hitTrees = {}
            for _,hit in ipairs(hits) do
                local tree:Model = CommonFunc:FindFirstAncestorByTag(hit,GameEnum.Tag.Tree) or CommonFunc:FindFirstAncestorByTag(hit,GameEnum.Tag.BigTree)
                if not tree or hitTrees[tree] then continue end
                hitTrees[tree] = true
                GameHelper:TreeTakeDamge(nil,tree,100)
                if tree.PrimaryPart then
                    AudioHelper:PlayEffect("树被撞击",tree.PrimaryPart)
                end
            end
        end
    end))
end
function onTagRemoved(enemy:Model)
    enemy:RemoveTag(GameEnum.Tag.NPCAutoJump)
end

    else
        ValueHelper:SetBonusValueValue(pickaxe,PickaxeValue.PickaxeRange,"基础",4)

    ValueHelper:SetBonusValueValue(pickaxe,PickaxeValue.PickaxeActivatedCD,"基础",v_baseATKCD.Value)

GameHelper.PickaxeHitC2S.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player,hits:{BasePart})
    if not GameHelper:isAlive(player) then return end

    local character = player.Character
    local pickaxe:Tool = character:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Tool")
    if not pickaxe or not pickaxe:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Pickaxe) then return end

    if #hits > 0 then
        local validHit = false
        local v_PickaxeATK:NumberValue = ValueHelper:WaitValue(pickaxe,PickaxeValue.PickaxeATK)
        for _,target:BasePart in ipairs(hits) do
            if target:IsDescendantOf(workspace.Prefabs) then continue end
            if not target:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.PickaxeTarget) then continue end

            validHit = true
            GameHelper:LodeTakeDamage(player,target,v_PickaxeATK.Value)

local PathfindingService = game:GetService("PathfindingService")
local CommonFunc = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("framework"):WaitForChild("CommonFunc"))
local CommonEnum = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Common"):WaitForChild("CommonEnum"))
local GameEnum = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("GameEnum"))
local ValueHelper = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("ValueHelper"))

CommonFunc:GetInstanceTagAddedSignal(GameEnum.Tag.NPCFollow,function(npc:Model, connections)
    npc:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.NPCAnimation)

    local humanoid:Humanoid = npc:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
    local v_NPCFollowTarget:ObjectValue = npc:WaitForChild("NPCFollowTarget")

    local nextCheckTime:number = 0
    local waypoints:{PathWaypoint} = nil
    local lastTargetPos:Vector3 = nil

    local path = PathfindingService:CreatePath({
        AgentRadius = 3,
        AgentHeight = 6,
        AgentCanJump = true,
        AgentCanClimb = false,
        WaypointSpacing = 100,
    })

    local moveToNextWaypoint = function()
        if not waypoints or #waypoints == 0 then return end
        local waypoint:PathWaypoint = table.remove(waypoints,1)
        if waypoint.Action == Enum.PathWaypointAction.Jump then
            humanoid.Jump = true
        end
        humanoid:MoveTo(waypoint.Position)
    end

    table.insert(connections,humanoid.HealthChanged:Connect(function()
        if humanoid.Health <= 0 then
            GameHelper:StopNPCFollow(npc)
        end
    end))

    table.insert(connections,humanoid.MoveToFinished:Connect(function(reached:boolean)
        moveToNextWaypoint()
    end))

    table.insert(connections,v_NPCFollowTarget.Changed:Connect(function()
        if v_NPCFollowTarget.Value then

        else
            lastTargetPos = nil
            local cframe = npc:GetPivot()
            humanoid:MoveTo(cframe.Position+cframe.LookVector)
            humanoid.WalkSpeed = 18
            GameHelper:StopNPCFollow(npc)
        end
    end))

    table.insert(connections,RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        local gameTimeNow = workspace.DistributedGameTime
        if gameTimeNow < nextCheckTime then return end
        nextCheckTime = gameTimeNow + 10

        if GameHelper:CharacterIsAlive(v_NPCFollowTarget.Value) then
            local target:Model = v_NPCFollowTarget.Value

            local targetHumanoid:Humanoid = target:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
            humanoid.WalkSpeed = targetHumanoid.WalkSpeed

            local targetCFrame = target:GetPivot()
            local targetPos = targetCFrame.Position
            if lastTargetPos ~= targetPos and (not lastTargetPos or (targetPos - lastTargetPos).Magnitude > 3) then
                local startPos = npc:GetPivot().Position
                lastTargetPos = targetPos

                local offset = targetPos - startPos
                local distance = offset.Magnitude
                if distance > 50 then
                    local endPos = targetPos - offset.Unit * 3
                    waypoints = nil
                    lastTargetPos = targetPos
                    npc:PivotTo(targetCFrame.Rotation + endPos)
                    humanoid:MoveTo(endPos)
                elseif distance > 3 then
                    local endPos = targetPos - offset.Unit * 3
                    -- 计算路径
                    local success, errorMessage = pcall(function()
                        path:ComputeAsync(startPos, endPos)
                    end)

                    -- 确认计算成功
                    if success and path.Status == Enum.PathStatus.Success then
                        -- 对于每个航点，创建一个部分以可视化路径
                        waypoints = path:GetWaypoints()
                        if RunService:IsStudio() then
                            -- for _, waypoint in waypoints do
                            --     local part = Instance.new("Part")
                            --     part.Position = waypoint.Position
                            --     part.Size = Vector3.new(0.5, 0.5, 0.5)
                            --     part.Color = Color3.new(1, 0, 1)
                            --     part.Anchored = true
                            --     part.CanCollide = false
                            --     part.CanQuery = false
                            --     part.CanTouch = false
                            --     part.Parent = workspace
                            --     Debris:AddItem(part,1)
                            -- end
                        end
               
                        if #waypoints > 0 then
                            -- 第一个点是起点，没用的，不移除会往回走
                            table.remove(waypoints,1)
                        end
                        moveToNextWaypoint()
                    else
                        -- warn(`路径无法计算，错误：{errorMessage}`)
                    end
                else
                    humanoid:Move(Vector3.zero)
                end
            end
        else
            v_NPCFollowTarget.Value = nil
        end

        nextCheckTime = workspace.DistributedGameTime + 1
    end))
end,function(npc:Model)
    if not npc:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then return end

    local humanoid:Humanoid = npc:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
    if humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
        humanoid:Move(Vector3.zero)
    end
end)"},{"id":372,"text":"local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")
local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local CommonFunc = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("framework"):WaitForChild("CommonFunc"))
local CommonEnum = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Common"):WaitForChild("CommonEnum"))
local GameEnum = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("GameEnum"))
local ValueHelper = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("ValueHelper"))

CommonFunc:GetInstanceTagAddedSignal(GameEnum.Tag.NPCAnimation,function(npc:Model, connections)
    local humanoid:Humanoid = npc:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
    local tool:Tool = npc:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Tool")

    local animations:Folder = npc:FindFirstChild("Animations")
    if not animations then return end

    local walkAnim:Animation = animations:FindFirstChild("walk")
    local idleAnim:Animation = animations:FindFirstChild("idle")
    local attackAnim:Animation = animations:FindFirstChild("attack")
    local toolAnim:Animation = animations:FindFirstChild("tool")
    local walkTrack:AnimationTrack
    local idleTrack:AnimationTrack
    local attackTrack:AnimationTrack
    local toolTrack:AnimationTrack
    if walkAnim then
        walkTrack = CommonFunc:LoadAnimation(npc,walkAnim)
        walkTrack.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Movement
        walkTrack.Looped = true
        walkTrack:Stop()
    end
    if attackAnim then
        attackTrack = CommonFunc:LoadAnimation(npc,attackAnim)
        attackTrack.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action2
        attackTrack.Looped = false
        attackTrack:Stop()
    end
    if idleAnim then
        idleTrack = CommonFunc:LoadAnimation(npc,idleAnim)
        idleTrack.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Idle
        idleTrack.Looped = true
        idleTrack:Play()
    end
    if toolAnim then
        toolTrack = CommonFunc:LoadAnimation(npc,toolAnim)
        toolTrack.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action
        toolTrack.Looped = true
        toolTrack:Stop()
    end

    if walkTrack then
        table.insert(connections,humanoid.Running:Connect(function(speed)
            if speed > 1 then
                if not walkTrack.IsPlaying then walkTrack:Play() end
            else
                if walkTrack.IsPlaying then walkTrack:Stop() end
            end
        end))
    end

    local onEquipTool = function(newTool:Tool)
        if toolTrack then
            toolTrack:Play()
        end

        if attackTrack then
            local con = newTool.Activated:Connect(function()
                attackTrack:Play()
            end)

            newTool.Unequipped:Once(function()
                con:Disconnect()
                if toolTrack then
                    toolTrack:Stop()
                end
            end)
        end
    end

    table.insert(connections,npc.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child:Instance)
        if child:IsA("Tool") then
            onEquipTool(child)
        end
    end))

    if tool then
        onEquipTool(tool)
    end
end)"},{"id":373,"text":"local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local CommonFunc = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("framework"):WaitForChild("CommonFunc"))
local GameEnum = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("GameEnum"))
local ResourcesItemHelper = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("ResourcesItemHelper"))
local GameHelper = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("GameHelper"))
local ToolHelper = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("ToolHelper"))
local ValueHelper = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("ValueHelper"))
local MeleeWeaponSetting = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("ExcelConfig"):WaitForChild("MeleeWeaponSetting"))

local Events = game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Events"):WaitForChild("Game")
local MeleeAttackC2S = Events:WaitForChild("MeleeAttackC2S")
local MeleeHitS2C = Events:WaitForChild("MeleeHitS2C")
local MeleeHitValidated = GameHelper.onPlayerMeleeWeaponValidatedHit
local newMeleeSwitch = game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("玩法开关"):WaitForChild("新版近战判定")

local states = {}
local queryCache = {}
local CharacterValue = ValueHelper.ValueModel.CharacterValue

local function getCharacterRoot(character: Model): BasePart?
    return character and (character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or character.PrimaryPart)
end

local function isAlive(character: Model): boolean
    local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    return humanoid ~= nil and humanoid.Health > 0 and getCharacterRoot(character) ~= nil
end

local function getQueryData(player: Player, character: Model)
    local cached = queryCache[player]
    if cached and cached.character == character then
        return cached
    end
    local overlap = OverlapParams.new()
    overlap.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    overlap.FilterDescendantsInstances = {character}
    overlap.CollisionGroup = GameEnum.CollisionGroup.IgnorePlayer
    overlap.MaxParts = 128

    local raycast = RaycastParams.new()
    raycast.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    raycast.FilterDescendantsInstances = {character}
    raycast.CollisionGroup = GameEnum.CollisionGroup.IgnorePlayer

    cached = {character = character, overlap = overlap, raycast = raycast}
    queryCache[player] = cached
    return cached
end

local function getValidatedTargetRoot(model: Model): BasePart?
    return model and (model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or model.PrimaryPart)
end

local function isCandidateModel(model: Model, character: Model): Model?
    if not model or not model:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then return nil end

    local isNpc, npc = GameHelper:IsNPC(model)
    npc = npc or model
    if not isNpc or npc == character or not npc:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then return nil end

    local humanoid = npc:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if humanoid and humanoid.Health <= 0 then return nil end
    if npc:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.EnemyDeath) then return nil end
    return npc
end

local function getTreeModel(instance: Instance): Model?
    local bigTree = CommonFunc:FindFirstAncestorByTag(instance, GameEnum.Tag.BigTree)
    if bigTree then return bigTree end
    return CommonFunc:FindFirstAncestorByTag(instance, GameEnum.Tag.Tree)
end

local function hasLineOfSight(root: BasePart, target: Model, raycast: RaycastParams): boolean
    local targetRoot = getValidatedTargetRoot(target)
    if not targetRoot then return false end
    local origin = root.Position + Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0)
    local destination = targetRoot.Position + Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0)
    local direction = destination - origin
    if direction:Dot(direction) <= 0.01 then return true end

    debug.profilebegin("Melee.Server.LineOfSight")
    local hit = workspace:Raycast(origin, direction, raycast)
    debug.profileend()
    return hit == nil or hit.Instance:IsDescendantOf(target)
end

local function getDamage(tool: Tool, targetKind: string): number?
    local resLo = ResourcesItemHelper:GetLoByItem(tool)
    if not resLo or not resLo.param then return nil end
    local params = string.split(tostring(resLo.param), ",")
    return tonumber(targetKind == "Tree" and (params[2] or params[1]) or params[1])
end

local function applyNpcHit(player: Player, target: Model, tool: Tool, profile, swingId: number): boolean
    local damage = getDamage(tool, "NPC")
    if not damage then return false end

    if tool:HasTag("LightSaber") and player:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.JediV3) then
        damage *= 1.5
    end

    local damageSource
    if profile.id == 147 and target:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Ghost) then
        damageSource = GameEnum.DamageSource.HolySword
    end
    local didDamage = GameHelper:PlayerMeleeWeaponHitTarget(player, target, damage, damageSource)
    if didDamage then
        MeleeHitValidated:Fire(player, target, tool, profile, damage, "NPC", swingId)
    end
    return didDamage == true
end

local function applyTreeHit(player: Player, target: Model, tool: Tool, profile, swingId: number): boolean
    if not tool:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Axe) then return false end
    if target:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.BigTree) and not tool:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.PowerAxe) then return false end

    local damage = getDamage(tool, "Tree")
    if not damage then return false end
    local attackBonus = ValueHelper:FindValueValue(player.Character, CharacterValue.attackBonus) or 0
    damage += damage * attackBonus

    local hp = target:GetAttribute("hp")
    if not hp or hp <= 0 then return false end
    local didDamage = GameHelper:TreeTakeDamge(player, target, damage)
    if not didDamage then return false end
    GameHelper:AddMuscle(player, 0.5)
    MeleeHitValidated:Fire(player, target, tool, profile, damage, "Tree", swingId)
    return true
end

local function applyResourceSphere(
    player: Player,
    root: BasePart,
    tool: Tool,
    profile,
    swingId: number,
    queryData
): number
    if not tool:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Axe) then return 0 end

    debug.profilebegin("Melee.Server.ResourceSphere")
    local parts = workspace:GetPartBoundsInRadius(root.Position, profile.reach, queryData.overlap)
    debug.profileend()

    local seen = {}
    local hitCount = 0
    for _, part: BasePart in ipairs(parts) do
        local tree = getTreeModel(part)
        if tree and not seen[tree] then
            seen[tree] = true
            local hp = tree:GetAttribute("hp")
            if hp and hp > 0 and applyTreeHit(player, tree, tool, profile, swingId) then
                hitCount += 1
            end
        end
    end
    return hitCount
end

local function clearPlayer(player: Player)
    states[player] = nil
    queryCache[player] = nil
end

local function handleSwing(player: Player, swingId)
    if not newMeleeSwitch.Value then return end
    if typeof(swingId) ~= "number" or swingId % 1 ~= 0 or swingId < 1 or swingId > 2147483647 then return end
    local character = player.Character
    if not isAlive(character) then return end

    local tool = ToolHelper:GetToolsInHand(player)
    if not tool or not (tool:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.MeleeWeapon) or tool:HasTag("LightSaber")) then return end

    local resLo = ResourcesItemHelper:GetLoByItem(tool)
    local profile = resLo and MeleeWeaponSetting.GetById(tonumber(resLo.id))
    if not profile then return end

    local now = os.clock()
    local state = states[player]
    if not state or state.character ~= character or state.tool ~= tool then
        state = {character = character, tool = tool, lastTime = 0, lastSwingId = 0}
        states[player] = state
    end
    if swingId <= state.lastSwingId then return end
    if now - state.lastTime < profile.cooldown then return end

    state.lastTime = now
    state.lastSwingId = swingId

    local root = getCharacterRoot(character)
    local queryData = getQueryData(player, character)
    applyResourceSphere(player, root, tool, profile, swingId, queryData)

    local rear = profile.rearAllowance
    local depth = profile.reach + rear
    local boxCFrame = root.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, (rear - profile.reach) * 0.5)
    local boxSize = Vector3.new(profile.width, profile.height, depth)

    debug.profilebegin("Melee.Server.Hitbox")
    local parts = workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(boxCFrame, boxSize, queryData.overlap)
    debug.profileend()

    local candidates = {}
    local seen = {}
    for _, part: BasePart in ipairs(parts) do
        local model = CommonFunc:GetModel(part)
        local npc = model and isCandidateModel(model, character)
        if npc and not seen[npc] then
            local targetRoot = getValidatedTargetRoot(npc)
            if targetRoot then
                -- boxCFrame is shifted forward to center the broad-phase query.
                -- The configured reach/rear bounds are relative to the character root,
                -- so the narrow-phase check must use the root coordinate space.
                local rootLocalPosition = root.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(targetRoot.Position)
                if math.abs(rootLocalPosition.X) <= profile.width * 0.5
                    and math.abs(rootLocalPosition.Y) <= profile.height * 0.5
                    and rootLocalPosition.Z >= -profile.reach
                    and rootLocalPosition.Z <= rear then
                    seen[npc] = true
                    local delta = targetRoot.Position - root.Position
                    table.insert(candidates, {model = npc, kind = "NPC", distance = delta:Dot(delta)})
                end
            end
        end
    end

    table.sort(candidates, function(a, b) return a.distance < b.distance end)

    local hitCount = 0
    local maxTargets = math.min(profile.maxTargets, 12)
    for i = 1, math.min(#candidates, maxTargets) do
        local candidate = candidates[i]
        if not profile.lineOfSight or hasLineOfSight(root, candidate.model, queryData.raycast) then
            if candidate.kind == "NPC" then
                if applyNpcHit(player, candidate.model, tool, profile, swingId) then
                    hitCount += 1
                end
            end
            if hitCount >= maxTargets then break end
        end
    end

    MeleeHitS2C:FireClient(player, swingId, hitCount)
end

MeleeAttackC2S.OnServerEvent:Connect(handleSwing)

local function watchPlayer(player: Player)
    player.CharacterRemoving:Connect(function()
        clearPlayer(player)
    end)
    player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
        clearPlayer(player)
    end)
end

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(clearPlayer)
for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
    watchPlayer(player)
end
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(watchPlayer)"},{"id":374,"text":"local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local GameEnum = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("GameEnum"))
local ValueHelper = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("ValueHelper"))
local EnemyHelper = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("EnemyHelper"))
local GameHelper = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("GameHelper"))
local EnemySetting = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("ExcelConfig"):WaitForChild("EnemySetting"))
local AudioHelper = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("AudioHelper"))

local visualEvent = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Events"):WaitForChild("Game"):FindFirstChild("NPCGunVisualS2C")
local enemyValue = ValueHelper.ValueModel.EnemyValue
local swingSounds = {"近战武器Swing1","近战武器Swing2"}
local hitSounds = {"近战武器Hit1","近战武器Hit2"}
local lastHitSoundAt = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
local lastPlayerHitSoundAt = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})

local MOUNTED_CONFIG = {
    chargePrepDistance = 28,
    chargeWindup = 0.35,
    chargeSpeed = 32,
    chargeDuration = 1.25,
    chargeRetreatDistance = 26,
    strafeOuterDistance = 24,
    strafeInnerDistance = 12,
    strafeDistance = 20,
    strafeSwitchTime = 2.5,
    meleeAttackWindup = 0.18,
    gunAttackWindup = 0.15,

    -- No-target patrol pacing is shared by every mounted enemy ID.
    patrolIdleMin = 5,
    patrolIdleMax = 9,
    patrolSpeedScale = 0.45,
    patrolArrivalDistance = 4,
    patrolMinRadiusScale = 0.30,
    patrolMaxRadiusScale = 0.60,
}


local records = {}
local schedulerAccumulator = 0
local schedulerConnection

-- Mounted riders are not handled by the ordinary Bandit animation stack. Emit the
-- existing spatial impact sound from the server-side damage event so every nearby
-- client hears a hit, including melee hits that touch the horse's collision shell.
GameHelper.onNpcTakeDamage.Event:Connect(function(_, npc, _, _, hitContext)
    if not npc or not npc:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.MountedEnemy) then return end
    if hitContext and hitContext.SuppressHitReaction then return end
    local now = os.clock()
    if now - (lastHitSoundAt[npc] or -math.huge) < 0.08 then return end
    lastHitSoundAt[npc] = now
    local root = npc:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or npc.PrimaryPart
    if root then
        pcall(function()
            AudioHelper:PlayEffect(hitSounds[math.random(1,#hitSounds)],root,{
                SourceKey = "mounted-hit:" .. tostring(npc),
                FallbackPosition = root.Position,
            })
        end)
    end
end)

-- Outgoing mounted melee feedback is driven by the authoritative player damage
-- event, so a sound is never emitted for a blocked, missed, immune, or stale hit.
GameHelper.onPlayerTakeDamage.Event:Connect(function(player, _, attacker, hitContext)
    if not player or not attacker or not attacker:IsA("Model") then return end
    if not attacker:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.MountedEnemy) then return end
    if not hitContext or hitContext.AttackKind ~= "MountedMelee" then return end
    local character = player.Character
    local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not root then return end
    local playerTimes = lastPlayerHitSoundAt[attacker]
    if not playerTimes then
        playerTimes = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
        lastPlayerHitSoundAt[attacker] = playerTimes
    end
    local now = os.clock()
    if now - (playerTimes[player] or -math.huge) < 0.08 then return end
    playerTimes[player] = now
    local key = tostring(attacker) .. ":" .. tostring(player.UserId)
    pcall(function()
        AudioHelper:PlayEffect(hitSounds[math.random(1,#hitSounds)],root,{
            SourceKey = "mounted-player-hit:" .. key,
            FallbackPosition = root.Position,
        })
    end)
end)

local function getRoot(model)
    return model and (model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or model.PrimaryPart)
end

local function getHumanoid(model)
    return model and model:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
end

local function characterIsAlive(character)
    local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
    local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    return humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 and root ~= nil, humanoid, root
end

local function setNetworkOwnerServer(model)
    if not model then return end
    for _, descendant in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
        if descendant:IsA("BasePart") then
            pcall(function()
                descendant:SetNetworkOwner(nil)
            end)
        end
    end
end

local function setSeatEnabled(horse, enabled)
    local seat = horse and horse:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Seat", true)
    if not seat then return end
    pcall(function()
        seat.Disabled = not enabled
    end)
    seat.CanTouch = enabled
end

local function setHorseScriptsEnabled(horse, enabled)
    if not horse then return end
    for _, descendant in ipairs(horse:GetDescendants()) do
        if descendant:IsA("BaseScript") then
            descendant.Enabled = enabled
        end
    end
end

local function findAnimation(folder, names)
    if not folder then return end
    for _, child in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
        if child:IsA("Animation") then
            local lower = string.lower(child.Name)
            for _, name in ipairs(names) do
                if lower == string.lower(name) then
                    return child
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

local function makeAnimation(name, assetId)
    local animation = Instance.new("Animation")
    animation.Name = name
    animation.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://" .. tostring(assetId)
    return animation
end

local function loadTrack(animator, animation, looped, priority)
    if not animator or not animation then return end
    local ok, track = pcall(function()
        return animator:LoadAnimation(animation)
    end)
    if not ok or not track then return end
    track.Looped = looped
    track.Priority = priority
    return track
end

local function playTrack(track, fadeTime)
    if track and not track.IsPlaying then
        pcall(function()
            track:Play(fadeTime or 0.1, 1, 1)
        end)
    end
end

local function stopTrack(track, fadeTime)
    if track and track.IsPlaying then
        pcall(function()
            track:Stop(fadeTime or 0.1)
        end)
    end
end

local function restartTrack(track, fadeTime)
    if not track then return end
    pcall(function()
        track:Stop(fadeTime or 0.03)
        track:Play(fadeTime or 0.03, 1, 1)
    end)
end

local function playHorseMovement(record, moving)
    if record.horseFall and record.horseHumanoid then
        local state = record.horseHumanoid:GetState()
        local falling = state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall
        if falling then
            stopTrack(record.horseWalk, 0.1)
            stopTrack(record.horseRide, 0.1)
            playTrack(record.horseFall, 0.1)
            return
        end
        stopTrack(record.horseFall, 0.1)
    end
    if moving then
        stopTrack(record.horseRide, 0.1)
        playTrack(record.horseWalk, 0.1)
    else
        stopTrack(record.horseWalk, 0.1)
        playTrack(record.horseRide, 0.1)
    end
end

local function isFrozen(model)
    return model:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Freezed) or model:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.NPCFreezed)
end
